newsitem.title: UK: RMC up amid continued short-squeeze.
newsitem.headline: RMC up amid continued short-squeeze.

text.p: Shares in building materials concern RMC Group jumped to its highest level in more than a year on a continued short-squeeze, first triggered by the German interest rate cut last Thursday, traders said.
By 1202 GMT, the shares were up 12p to 1126p after having climbed as high as 1132, a new high for the year.
The shares have gained 74p, or about seven percent, since Thursday, when the Bundesbank announced a larger-than-expected reduction in key interest rates.
RMC was a big beneficiary or the rate cut because of the large amount of business it does in German, traders said.
"Marketmakers were caught short last week and I think they're still pretty short," said one.
